meta.title: NewsTheme demo
meta.description: The free NewsTheme WordPress theme by FutureLabs Studio, with its demo content.
meta.author: FutureLabs Studio

steps.code:
<?php
// Point the demo's stored URLs (a placeholder) at this Playground's own address.
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
global $wpdb;
$from = 'https://newstheme-preview.invalid';
$to   = untrailingslashit( home_url() );
$swap = function ( $v ) use ( &$swap, $from, $to ) {
	if ( is_string( $v ) ) {
		return str_replace( $from, $to, $v );
	}
	if ( is_array( $v ) ) {
		return array_map( $swap, $v );
	}
	if ( is_object( $v ) ) {
		foreach ( get_object_vars( $v ) as $k => $x ) {
			$v->$k = $swap( $x );
		}
	}
	return $v;
};
$like = '%' . $wpdb->esc_like( $from ) . '%';
foreach ( array( 'post_content', 'post_excerpt', 'guid' ) as $col ) {
	$wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare( "UPDATE {$wpdb->posts} SET $col = REPLACE($col, %s, %s) WHERE $col LIKE %s", $from, $to, $like ) );
}
foreach ( array( array( $wpdb->postmeta, 'meta_id', 'meta_value' ), array( $wpdb->termmeta, 'meta_id', 'meta_value' ), array( $wpdb->options, 'option_id', 'option_value' ) ) as list( $table, $id, $col ) ) {
	foreach ( $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT $id AS id, $col AS v FROM $table WHERE $col LIKE %s", $like ) ) as $row ) {
		$wpdb->update( $table, array( $col => maybe_serialize( $swap( maybe_unserialize( $row->v ) ) ) ), array( $id => $row->id ) );
	}
}
wp_cache_flush();
